\newcommand{\vpaddplate}[1]{%
  \expandafter\gdef\expandafter\vpplatecode\expandafter{\vpplatecode#1}}
\newcommand{\vplane}[2]{\vpaddplate{\node[vpactorplate] at (#1,-0.3) {#2};}}
\newcommand{\vplaneadv}[2]{%
  \gdef\vpadvlane{#1}\vpaddplate{\node[vpactorplateadv] at (#1,-0.3) {#2};}}

\newcommand{\vplifelines}[2]{%
  \begin{scope}[on background layer]
    \foreach \vpi in {0,...,\the\numexpr\thevplanes-1\relax} {
      \ifnum\vpi=\vpadvlane\relax
        \draw[vplifeadv] (\vpi,#1) -- (\vpi,#2);
      \else
        \draw[vplife] (\vpi,#1) -- (\vpi,#2);
      \fi
    }
  \end{scope}}

\newcommand{\vpstrip}[3]{%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\vph}{#1}%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\vpy}{-\vph/2}%
  \begin{lrbox}{\vpstripbox}%
  \begin{tikzpicture}[x=\vplanesep,y=1cm]%
    #3%
    \vplifelines{#2}{-\vph}%
    \pgfresetboundingbox
    \path[use as bounding box]
      ($(0,0)+(-0.5\vpboxw-\vpleftgut,0)$) rectangle
      ($({\thevplanes-1},-\vph)+(0.5\vpboxw+\vprightgut,0)$);
  \end{tikzpicture}%
  \end{lrbox}}

\newcommand{\vpappend}{%
  \global\setbox\vpall\vbox{%
    \unvbox\vpall
    \ifvpholdnext\penalty10000 \else\penalty0 \fi
    \nointerlineskip
    \hbox to\linewidth{\hss\scalebox{\vpscale}{\usebox{\vpstripbox}}\hss}}%
  \global\vpholdnextfalse}

\newcommand{\vprow}[2]{\vpstrip{#1}{0}{#2}\vpappend}

% Step numbers sit in the left margin, clear of every lane.
\newcommand{\vpstep}[2]{%
  \if\relax\detokenize{#2}\relax\else
    \node[#1] at (0,\vpy) [xshift=-0.5\vpboxw-\vpnumgut] {#2};
  \fi}

\newcommand{\vpwire}[8]{%
  \ifnum#2>-1\relax\def\vpfrom{#2}\else\def\vpfrom{#1}\fi
  \pgfmathsetlength{\vpspan}{max(1.2cm,abs(#3-\vpfrom)*\vplanesep-0.7cm)}%
  \setbox\vpmeasure\hbox{\footnotesize#7}%
  \ifdim\wd\vpmeasure>\vpspan
    \setbox\vpmeasure\hbox{\parbox{\vpspan}{\centering\footnotesize#7}}%
    \tikzset{vpwrap/.style={text width=\vpspan,align=center,anchor=south,
      fill=none,yshift=1pt}}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\vprowh}{(\ht\vpmeasure+\dp\vpmeasure)/1cm+0.62}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\vparrowy}{-\vprowh+0.3}%
  \else
    \tikzset{vpwrap/.style={}}%
    \def\vprowh{\vprowsep}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\vparrowy}{-\vprowh/2}%
  \fi
  \vprow{\vprowh}{%
    \let\vpy\vparrowy
    \ifnum#2>-1\relax\draw[vpmuted] (#1,\vpy) -- (#2,\vpy);\fi
    \draw[vparrow,#4] (\vpfrom,\vpy) -- (#3,\vpy) node[#8,midway,vpwrap]{#7};
    \vpstep{#5}{#6}}}

\newcommand{\vphop}[7]{\vpwire{#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}{#5}{#6}{#7}{vplabel}}
\newcommand{\vphopforged}[7]{\vpwire{#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}{#5}{#6}{#7}{vplabeladv}}

\newcommand{\vpphase}[1]{%
  \vprow{0.62}{%
    \begin{scope}[on background layer]
      \draw[vprule,line width=0.5pt,dash pattern=on 2.4pt off 2.4pt]
        ($(0,\vpy)+(-0.5\vpboxw-\vpnumgut,0)$) -- ($({\thevplanes-1},\vpy)+(0.5\vpboxw,0)$);
    \end{scope}
    \node[vpphaselabel,anchor=west,fill=white,inner xsep=4pt]
      at (0,\vpy) [xshift=-0.5\vpboxw-\vpnumgut] {phase #1};}%
  \global\vpholdnexttrue}

\newcommand{\vpmark}[5]{%
  \vprow{\vprowsep}{\node[#2] at (#1,\vpy) {#5};\vpstep{#3}{#4}}}

\newcommand{\vprun}[4]{%
  \vprow{\vprowsep}{\node[vpnote] at (#1,\vpy) {#4};\vpstep{#2}{#3}}}

\newcommand{\vpboxwidth}[2]{%
  \setlength{\vpthisw}{\vpboxw}%
  \ifnum#1>0\relax\ifnum#1<\numexpr\thevplanes-1\relax
    \setlength{\vpthisw}{\vpwidew}%
  \fi\fi
  \addtolength{\vpthisw}{-10pt}%
  \global\vpwidest=0pt
  \begingroup
    \def\vpactline##1{%
      \setbox0\hbox{\scriptsize##1}%
      \ifdim\wd0>\vpwidest\global\vpwidest=\wd0\fi}%
    #2%
  \endgroup
  \ifdim\vpwidest<\vpthisw\setlength{\vpthisw}{\vpwidest}\fi
  \ifdim\vpthisw<\dimexpr\vpboxw-10pt\relax
    \setlength{\vpthisw}{\dimexpr\vpboxw-10pt\relax}%
  \fi}

\newcommand{\vpboxrow}[3]{%
  \vpboxwidth{#2}{#3}%
  \global\vplinecount=0
  \begingroup\def\vpactline##1{\global\advance\vplinecount by 1 }#3\endgroup
  \global\vplineat=0
  \begingroup
    \tikzset{vpboxnow/.style={#1}}\def\vpboxlane{#2}\let\vpactline\vpslice
    #3%
  \endgroup}

\newcommand{\vpslice}[1]{%
  \global\advance\vplineat by 1
  \ifnum\vplineat=1 \vpfirstslicetrue\else\vpfirstslicefalse\fi
  \ifnum\vplineat=\vplinecount\vplastslicetrue\else\vplastslicefalse\fi
  \setbox\vpmeasure\hbox{\parbox[t]{\vpthisw}{\scriptsize\raggedright\strut#1\strut}}%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\vptop}{\ifvpfirstslice\vpboxgap+\vpboxpad\else0\fi}%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\vpyt}{\ifvpfirstslice-\vpboxgap\else0\fi}%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\vpyb}%
    {-(\vptop+(\ht\vpmeasure+\dp\vpmeasure)/1cm+\ifvplastslice\vpboxpad\else0\fi)}%
  \vprow{0-(\vpyb)+\ifvplastslice\vpboxgap\else0\fi}{%
    \coordinate (vptl) at ($(\vpboxlane,\vpyt)+(-0.5\vpthisw-5pt,0)$);
    \coordinate (vptr) at ($(\vpboxlane,\vpyt)+(0.5\vpthisw+5pt,0)$);
    \coordinate (vpbl) at ($(\vpboxlane,\vpyb)+(-0.5\vpthisw-5pt,0)$);
    \coordinate (vpbr) at ($(\vpboxlane,\vpyb)+(0.5\vpthisw+5pt,0)$);
    \ifvpfirstslice
      \ifvplastslice
        \path[vpboxnow,rounded corners=1.5pt] (vptl) rectangle (vpbr);
      \else
        \path[vpboxnow,rounded corners=1.5pt] (vpbl) -- (vptl) -- (vptr) -- (vpbr);
      \fi
    \else
      \ifvplastslice
        \path[vpboxnow,rounded corners=1.5pt] (vptl) -- (vpbl) -- (vpbr) -- (vptr);
      \else
        \path[vpboxnow,draw=none] (vptl) rectangle (vpbr);
        \path[vpboxnow,fill=none] (vptl) -- (vpbl) (vptr) -- (vpbr);
      \fi
    \fi
    \node[vpboxtext,anchor=north west,inner sep=0pt]
      at ($(\vpboxlane,-\vptop)+(-0.5\vpthisw,0)$) {\usebox{\vpmeasure}};}}

\newcommand{\vpcontinuednote}{%
  \if\relax\detokenize\expandafter{\vpfigref}\relax\else
    \hbox to\linewidth{\hfil\footnotesize\color{vpslate}%
      \figurename~\ref{\vpfigref}, continued}%
    \vskip3pt
  \fi}

\newcommand{\vpemitchunk}[1]{%
  \vbox{%
    \ifvpcontinued\vpcontinuednote\fi
    \offinterlineskip
    \copy\vpplates
    \box#1}}

\newcommand{\vpsplitloop}{%
  \vpfirst=\vpavail
  \advance\vpfirst by -\ht\vpplates
  \advance\vpfirst by -1cm
  \ifdim\vpfirst<3cm
    \vpfirst=\textheight
    \advance\vpfirst by -\ht\vpplates
  \fi
  \splittopskip=0pt
  \splitmaxdepth=\maxdimen
  \vbadness=10000
  \loop
    \vptmp=\vpfirst
    \advance\vptmp by -\vpreserve
    \ifdim\ht\vpall>\vptmp
      \ifdim\ht\vpall>\vpfirst\else\vpfirst=\vptmp\fi
      \setbox\vpchunk=\vsplit\vpall to \vpfirst
      \setbox\vpchunk=\vbox{\unvbox\vpchunk}%
    \else
      \setbox\vpchunk=\box\vpall
    \fi
    \vpemitchunk{\vpchunk}%
    \vpcontinuedtrue
    \ifvoid\vpall\vpmorefalse\else\vpmoretrue\fi
  \ifvpmore
    \penalty-10000
    \vpfirst=\textheight
    \advance\vpfirst by -\ht\vpplates
    \advance\vpfirst by -0.7cm
  \repeat}

\newcommand{\vpemit}{%
  \vptmp=\ht\vpall
  \advance\vptmp by \ht\vpplates
  \advance\vptmp by \vpreserve
  \ifdim\pagegoal=\maxdimen
    \vpavail=\textheight
  \else
    \vpavail=\pagegoal
    \advance\vpavail by -\pagetotal
  \fi
  \vpcontinuedfalse
  \vpsplitfalse
  \ifinner\else
    \ifdim\vptmp>\vpavail
      \ifdim\vptmp>\textheight
        \vpsplittrue
      \else
        \ifdim\vpavail>0.5\textheight\vpsplittrue\fi
      \fi
    \fi
  \fi
  \ifvpsplit\vpsplitloop\else\vpemitchunk{\vpall}\fi
  \nopagebreak}

  \pgfmathsetlength{\vpwidew}{max(\vpboxw,min(10cm,2*\vplanesep-1.2cm))}%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\vpscale}%
    {min(1,\linewidth/((#2-1)*\vplanesep+\vpboxw+\vpleftgut+\vprightgut))}%
  \global\setbox\vpall\vbox{}%
}{%

  \global\setbox\vpplates\hbox to\linewidth{\hss\scalebox{\vpscale}{\usebox{\vpstripbox}}\hss}%
  \vpemit}

\noindent This report describes the analysis of the Verifpal model \texttt{golden.vp} against an active attacker, with each principal running 2 concurrent sessions. Of its 2 queries, 1 was broken. Every attack reported here is a witness against the model as written. A query reported as holding means that this search found no attack at these parameters, which is not a proof that none exists.

\subsection{Attacks}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\textsf{confidentiality?}~\vpterm{\vpconst{m}}}{confidentiality? m}}
\label{atk:golden-vp-0-0}
\noindent m is obtained by \vpactor{Attacker}, so confidentiality? m does not hold.
\par\nopagebreak
%% --- BEGIN verifpal figure: golden-vp-0-attack-0 ---
%% Self-contained: needs only the verifpal preamble block.
\par\medskip
\begin{vpdiagram}[fig:golden-vp-0-attack-0]{3}
\vplane{0}{Bob}
\vplane{1}{Alice}
\vplaneadv{2}{Attacker}
\vpleak{0}{\vpleaks{\vpterm{\vpconst{b}}}}
\vprun{2}{vpnumwide}{1--3}{computes}
\vphopforged{1}{2}{0}{vpforged}{vpnumadv}{4}{\vpdagger{\vpguarded{\vpterm{\vpconst{ga}}}}, \vpterm{\vpconst{e}}}
\vpmark{0}{vpnote}{vpnumadv}{5}{check passes}
\vpmark{1}{vpnoteadv}{vpnumadv}{6}{check defeated}
\vprun{2}{vpnumwide}{7--8}{computes}
\end{vpdiagram}
\captionof{figure}{How the attacker breaks \textnormal{\textsf{confidentiality?}~\vpterm{\vpconst{m}}}. Substituted values carry a dagger.}
\label{fig:golden-vp-0-attack-0}
\par\medskip
%% --- END verifpal figure: golden-vp-0-attack-0 ---


\begin{vptrace}
\item \vpactor{Attacker} constructs \vpterm{\vpprimo{PUBKEY}(\vpconst{nil})} from nil.
\item \vpactor{Attacker} is handed \vpterm{\vpconst{b}} by a leaks declaration.
\item \vpactor{Attacker} obtains \vpterm{\vpconst{ga}} on the wire.
\item \vpactor{Attacker} replaces \vpterm{\vpconst{ga}} with \vpterm{\vpprimo{PUBKEY}(\vpconst{nil})}.\vpon{Alice}{Bob}
\item \vpactor{Bob}'s \vpterm{\vpprim{AEAD}{DEC}\vpchecked{}(\vpconst{k},\vpsep \vpconst{n},\vpsep \vpconst{e},\vpsep \vpconst{ad})} check passes on an attacker-controlled key.
\item \vpactor{Alice}'s \vpterm{\vpprimo{SIGNVERIF}} check is defeated, accepting \vpterm{\vpprimo{PUBKEY}(\vpconst{nil})}.
\item \vpactor{Attacker} computes \vpterm{\vpprim{DH}{KEX}(\vpprimo{PUBKEY}(\vpconst{a}),\vpsep \vpconst{nil})}, obtaining k.
\item \vpactor{Attacker} decrypts \vpterm{\vpconst{e}}, obtaining m.
\end{vptrace}



\noindent \vpactor{Bob} still sends ack to \vpactor{Alice}, so the failure counts.



\subsection{Scope and assumptions}
\noindent Every verdict above was reached against an active attacker, with each principal running 2 concurrent sessions, over exactly the model as written. An attack is a witness and stands on its own. A query reported as holding says only that this search found no attack at those parameters: the search space this engine defines was explored, which is never the space of all attacks. Some searches in this run stopped short even of that (term depth), so their holds cover less still.

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em,itemsep=2pt,topsep=4pt,label={\color{vpslate}\textbullet}]
\item The model assumes \vpterm{\vpprimo{HASH}(\vpconst{m})} is weak from phase 2 onward, which weakens it deliberately.
\item Scenario: Alice runs with \vpterm{\vpconst{gpeer}} as \vpterm{\vpconst{gm}}, a compromised peer.
\item Per-session values and principals carry the suffix \#2.
\end{itemize}




\appendix
\section{On soundness}
\noindent Verifpal is sound but incomplete. Every attack shown here is a genuine attack on the model as written; a query reported as holding means no attack was found within the search this run performed, which is never a proof that none exists.

phase[1]

	d = AEAD_DEC(k, n, e, ad)?
